Sarko.name: Shield Guard
Sarko.description: Protect yourself and nearby allies in front of your shield.

Sarko.name: Radiant Mark
Sarko.description: Mark a foe so your team deals greater damage; enables marked combat openings.

Sarko.name: Minor Restoration
Sarko.description: Restore the nearest wounded ally or yourself at close range.

Sarko.name: Miraculous Heal
Sarko.description: Restore health to yourself and nearby living allies; does not revive.

Sarko.name: Sanctuary
Sarko.description: Create a radial protective field; its name evolves with earned story gifts.

Sarko.name: Shared Burden
Sarko.description: Share incoming harm among nearby living allies.

Sarko.name: Light of Renewal
Sarko.description: Restore nearby allies over several healing pulses.

Sarko.name: Guardian's Covenant
Sarko.description: Grant nearby living allies a stronger protective ward.

Levi.name: Apostle's Advance
Levi.description: Advance into a focused forward sword strike.

Levi.name: Resolute Assault
Levi.description: Strengthen your attacks for a short time.

Levi.name: Formation Seven
Levi.description: Protect nearby allies and call companions into formation.

Levi.name: Steady Resolve
Levi.description: Recover your own health with brief protection.

Levi.name: Radiant Judgment
Levi.description: Deliver a powerful extended frontal judgment strike.

Levi.name: Guiding Parry
Levi.description: Prepare a riposte after successfully blocking an enemy strike.

Levi.name: Rallying Command
Levi.description: Protect nearby allies and briefly strengthen your own attacks.

Levi.name: Measured Rebuke
Levi.description: Deliver a narrow strike that strongly staggers a foe.

Waiz.name: Tendon Cut
Waiz.description: Cut low with both blades and briefly hinder nearby foes.

Waiz.name: Guardian's Passage
Waiz.description: Evade while granting protection to nearby allies.

Waiz.name: Courageous Witness
Waiz.description: Rally nearby living allies with healing and brief protection.

Waiz.name: Radiant Wind
Waiz.description: Cut a broad arc and shift sideways through the opening.

Waiz.name: Crosswind Flurry
Waiz.description: Deliver a sequence of rapid alternating strikes.

Waiz.name: Twin-Blade Counter
Waiz.description: Prepare a dual-blade riposte after a successful block.

Waiz.name: Opening Strike
Waiz.description: Strike a narrow opening; deals extra power against a marked foe.

Amaya.name: Piercing Current
Amaya.description: Drive the spear through a frontal arc; evolves into Storm Piercer.

Amaya.name: Watchful Counter
Amaya.description: Prepare a spear riposte after a successful block.

Amaya.name: Weak-Point Thrust
Amaya.description: Concentrate a powerful thrust into a narrow weak point.

Amaya.name: Renewed Focus
Amaya.description: Recover your health and briefly protect yourself.

Amaya.name: Thunder Breaker
Amaya.description: Deliver a powerful wider spear strike with strong knockback.

Amaya.name: Vanguard Step
Amaya.description: Evade and briefly protect yourself while repositioning.

Amaya.name: Sweeping Guard
Amaya.description: Sweep the spear broadly to drive foes back.

Amaya.name: Pinning Thrust
Amaya.description: Thrust narrowly and briefly hinder a foe in front.

Naomi.name: Foresight
Naomi.description: Read nearby danger and signal safer movement.

Naomi.name: Sheltering Word
Naomi.description: Heal nearby living allies and grant a protective ward.

Naomi.name: Discernment
Naomi.description: Read a wider area of danger and briefly protect the group.

Naomi.name: Steadfast Counsel
Naomi.description: Restore nearby allies with steadying protection.

Naomi.name: Guided Bolt
Naomi.description: Fire a precise bolt with partial armor penetration.

Naomi.name: Pinning Bolt
Naomi.description: Fire a bolt that briefly binds its target.

Naomi.name: Safe Passage
Naomi.description: Protect nearby allies and call companions into formation.

Naomi.name: Warning Bolt
Naomi.description: Fire a lighter bolt that strongly staggers its target.

Hailey.name: Binding Shot
Hailey.description: Fire a powerful arrow that briefly binds its target.

Hailey.name: Retreating Shot
Hailey.description: Step backward while firing a forward arrow.

Hailey.name: Piercing Star
Hailey.description: Fire a precise arrow with strong armor penetration.

Hailey.name: Regenerative Focus
Hailey.description: Focus your natural regeneration to restore your own health; no revival.

Hailey.name: Celestial Rain
Hailey.description: Release the earned rain of arrows.

Hailey.name: Celestial Volley
Hailey.description: Fire three arrows across a narrow fan.

Hailey.name: Heartseeker
Hailey.description: Fire a powerful penetrating arrow with added stagger.

Diago.name: Resolute Cleave
Diago.description: Deliver a powerful broad cleaving strike.

Diago.name: Groundbreaker
Diago.description: Strike around yourself to stagger and drive back foes.

Diago.name: Mentor's Measure
Diago.description: Deliver a measured heavy strike with strong stagger.

Diago.name: Second Wind
Diago.description: Recover your health with brief protection.

Diago.name: Guarding Lesson
Diago.description: Ward allies in front and prepare a riposte after a successful block.

Diago.name: Disarming Blow
Diago.description: Deliver a narrow strike that strongly staggers a foe.

Diago.name: Teacher's Rebuke
Diago.description: Drive foes back with a broad rebuking strike.

Diago.name: Stand Together
Diago.description: Grant nearby allies a lasting protective ward.

Magnar.name: Stonewall Brace
Magnar.description: Brace to protect yourself and nearby allies in front.

Magnar.name: Earthbreaker
Magnar.description: Strike with the hammer and raise the earned earthworks.

Magnar.name: Stand for Another
Magnar.description: Protect nearby allies who are fighting beside you.

Magnar.name: Steadfast Heart
Magnar.description: Recover your health and brace against incoming harm.

Magnar.name: Fortress Dominion
Magnar.description: Raise protective earthworks and ward nearby allies.

Magnar.name: Fortress Titan
Magnar.description: Advance with the earned titan impact and a heavy frontal strike.

Magnar.name: Fortress Descent
Magnar.description: Deliver a heavy surrounding impact with earthworks.

Magnar.name: Hammer Riposte
Magnar.description: Prepare a heavy hammer riposte after a successful block.
